dialogues.speaker: Sharp
dialogues.text: If you know the first thing about me, you'll keep away from my VIP.

dialogues.speaker: Sharp
dialogues.text: Tsk. Of course. You wouldn't know.

dialogues.speaker: Sharp
dialogues.text: PSD, personal security detachment. Bodyguard. We take the hit, so our clients don't have to.

dialogues.speaker: Sharp
dialogues.text: Personally, I much prefer "merc for hire." But now that I work for them, they've insisted on PSD.
